title: A feasibility boundary for attractor state transitions: code and derived data
description: Closed-form theory, numerical verification and empirical analysis for a feasibility boundary on perturbation-driven transitions between attractor states, with an application to resting-state dynamics in autism. Includes the full simulation and analysis pipeline, the simulation library, all derived participant-level quantities, the statistical output and all figures. Raw imaging data are not redistributed; they are fetched at run time from the public ABIDE Preprocessed S3 bucket.
